requirement_text: US High School diploma obtained outside of the USA if obtained with a minimum of 4 AP courses or other advanced coursework, taken in the final three years of high school. If you took fewer or no AP's or advanced courses, we also welcome you to apply, however we advise you to do so with a SAT or ACT score. In addition, the school where the candidate studied and obtained his/her degree must be accredited by one of the following organizations: Middle States Association of Colleges and Schools (MSACS); Western Association of Schools and Colleges (WASC); Cognia; New England Association of Schools and Colleges (NEASC)

limitations: Three stacked conditions: the diploma must be from outside the USA, must carry 4+ AP or advanced courses taken in the final three years, and the SCHOOL must hold one of four named US accreditations. The accreditation condition is a fact about the institution the student attended, not about the student.
researcher_notes: Directly relevant to ORYN's international-school user base -- a student at an American school in Istanbul or Dubai is eligible or not depending on which body accredits their school, which is not something a profile currently records. Also note AP count functions as an eligibility gate here, not as a strength signal.

requirement_text: TOEFL -- We only accept the TOEFL iBT test (including the Home Edition and Paper Edition). The minimum overall score is 79. We do not accept MyBest scores.
source_authority_note: kuleuven.be is the official domain of KU Leuven (website_url on the matched universities row is https://www.kuleuven.be); eng.kuleuven.be is its Faculty of Engineering Science subdomain and resolves to the same parent under domainMatches(). Belgian national domain; fails looksOfficial(). Needs official-domain provenance, piece (A), recorded as kuleuven.be so both the central and faculty hosts are covered.
limitations: 79 is unambiguously the legacy 0-120 scale (it is not expressible on the 1-6 scale), but the page names no scale and no cutover date. It survives today only because ETS supplies a comparable 0-120 overall for two years. When that ends in January 2028 this threshold becomes unmeetable with no page edit and no warning -- exactly the failure mode scalar-thresholds-are-not-enough.md predicts. No subtest requirement, so it is not partially unsatisfiable today.
researcher_notes: KU LEUVEN'S OWN FACULTY PAGE HANDLES THIS CORRECTLY (see the next record). The central admissions page does not. Not recorded as CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE because the two are reconcilable by scope -- the central page explicitly says programmes may set higher requirements -- but the central page's unqualified 79 is defective on its own terms regardless of that reconciliation.

requirement_text: TOEFL iBT: as of 21 January 2026, TOEFL iBT score reports use a new 1-6 scoring scale: For the test results obtained before this transition, the minimum required overall score is 94 (with no subscore below 22). For TOEFL iBT tests taken on or after 21 January 2026, the minimum required overall score is 5 (with no subscore below 4.5).

Belgian national domain; fails looksOfficial(). Needs official-domain provenance, piece (A), recorded as kuleuven.be so both the central and faculty hosts are covered.
researcher_notes: Best-in-corpus handling by an individual faculty: full date, both scales, and crucially the SUBSCORE stated on the correct scale for each side (22 on 0-30 before, 4.5 on 1-6 after). This is the pattern Glasgow, Bogazici and Lund all fail. That one KU Leuven faculty gets it right while KU Leuven's central admissions page does not is the strongest available argument that the scale qualifier has to be a stored field rather than left to whoever writes the page.
